decisions.statement: What a visit withdraws and deposits is bounded by backpack room and storage room, never by a count.
Every backpack slot is judged afresh when the bank opens.
A visit stacks the backpack and the storage it opened once every move that visit plans has settled.
A visit whose bank closed early stacks the bags it opened all the same.
Stacking waits for the moves to arrive rather than only for them to leave.
A stacking record reaching a later visit than the one it is of is dropped.
The setting that stacks the backpack at login is the setting that stacks here.

definition: what happens when the bank opens, and the one move used by every bank step
